name: breadcrumbs
author: lumine-code
description: Show file and symbol paths above each editor.
backgroundTips: Breadcrumbs show the active file and symbol path above each editor.

filePath.title: File Path
filePath.description: Show the full file path, only the file name, or no file path.

symbolPath.title: Symbol Path
symbolPath.description: Show the full symbol path, only the innermost symbol, or no symbols.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Show file, folder, and symbol icons in breadcrumbs.

scrollZone.title: Scroll zone
scrollZone.description: Where the cursor lands after clicking a symbol, as a % of viewport height. One value e.g. `25` always scrolls it there. Two are a band it may sit in untouched: `0, 50` moves it to the edge it crossed, `50, 0` throws it to the opposite edge for maximum room ahead. 0 = top margin, 100 = bottom margin.
